The in-process implementation wraps a {@link JlsmTable.StringKeyed} directly. 15→ * Future remote implementations will serialize operations over a network transport. 16→ * 17→ *

18→ * Governed by: .decisions/table-partitioning/adr.md — remote-capable interface designed for future 19→ * network transport. 20→ */ 21→public interface PartitionClient extends Closeable { 22→ 23→ /** 24→ * Returns the descriptor for this partition. 25→ * 26→ * @return the partition descriptor 27→ */ 28→ PartitionDescriptor descriptor(); 29→ 30→ /** 31→ * Creates a document in this partition. 32→ * 33→ * @param key the document key 34→ * @param doc the document to create 35→ * @throws IOException if the write fails 36→ * @throws DuplicateKeyException if the key already exists 37→ */ 38→ void create(String key, JlsmDocument doc) throws IOException; 39→ 40→ /** 41→ * Retrieves a document by key from this partition. 42→ * 43→ * @param key the document key 44→ * @return the document, or empty if not found 45→ * @throws IOException if the read fails 46→ */ 47→ Optional get(String key) throws IOException; 48→ 49→ /** 50→ * Updates a document in this partition. 51→ * 52→ * @param key the document key 53→ * @param doc the updated document 54→ * @param mode replace or patch 55→ * @throws IOException if the write fails 56→ * @throws KeyNotFoundException if the key does not exist 57→ */ 58→ void update(String key, JlsmDocument doc, UpdateMode mode) throws IOException; 59→ 60→ /** 61→ * Deletes a document from this partition. 62→ * 63→ * @param key the document key 64→ * @throws IOException if the write fails 65→ */ 66→ void delete(String key) throws IOException; 67→ 68→ /** 69→ * Returns entries in this partition within the given key range. 70→ * 71→ * @param fromKey inclusive lower bound 72→ * @param toKey exclusive upper bound 73→ * @return iterator over matching entries 74→ * @throws IOException if the read fails 75→ */ 76→ Iterator> getRange(String fromKey, String toKey) throws IOException; 77→ 78→ /** 79→ * Executes a predicate query against this partition, returning matching entries. 80→ * 81→ *
